network.transport: WIFI through Tailscale VPN, verified before and after tests

methodology.execution: Temporary release-mode Android ARM64 executable; imports unchanged production engine.rs, input_queue.rs, activity.rs and updates.rs plus rexlink-core
methodology.app_installation: Existing non-debuggable release not replaced; preferences and current selection not changed
methodology.fixtures: One disposable raw Python PTY per owned server, destroyed in finally cleanup
methodology.metric: Native input dispatch to received/decoded/published Ghostty frame, polling every 2ms; excludes Android input dispatch, JNI packet transfer, Kotlin, Canvas and pixel presentation
methodology.isolated: 5 warmups then 30 measured one-character inputs; 40ms pause after observed echo
methodology.burst: 80 one-character commands at 40ms intervals (25 keys/sec), production eight-request window; timing earlier keys from first observed later counter is an upper bound
methodology.comparison: Same S22+, native sources, executable, servers, sample counts, fixture and injection schedules as earlier 5G run; sequential comparison, not a controlled isolation of radio vs relay effects

burst.note: coalesced frames attribute earlier keys to their first observed later counter

mac.process: standalone Android executable using unchanged production Actor/Control/Replica source

route_probe.scope: Physical Mac Tailscale client to phone, separate from embedded Rex virtual-node routes
route_probe.limitation: Does not prove either embedded Rex node uses the same route

rendering_cpu.conclusion: No key-to-pixel, foreground CPU or battery claim

interpretation: Wi-Fi native echo was about 4.2–4.3 times faster at the median, with lower p95/max delays in this short sample. No sustained native typing queue at 25 keys/sec. Network-path differences are a substantial contributor; radio/access-network and route effects were not isolated.
cleanup: Both disposable sessions destroyed; temporary executable and shared library removed from phone; installed app/preferences/current session and network/server configuration left unchanged
